answer: Proof of Stake functions as a tundra of high-entry barriers where AI agents must lock capital to earn consensus authority. By requiring financial skin in the game, the system transforms a potential sybil oasis into a costly meadow of validator nodes. An attacker attempting to spin up multiple identities incurs significant liquidity opportunity costs, as proportional stake dilution renders the subversion economically irrational compared to the yield gained from honest participation.
